description:
Versionly monitors third-party APIs in your GitHub repos (Stripe, Twilio, and more). When a vendor ships a breaking change, Versionly maps impact to your call sites, explains what broke, and can open a fix pull request for you to review.

Connect your Versionly account to ask about scans, findings, monitored APIs, repos, and billing — and to trigger impact analysis or auto-fix workflows from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Check if any of my monitored APIs have breaking changes and show which files in my repo are affected.
List my connected GitHub repos and which third-party APIs Versionly is monitoring for each.
Explain the latest breaking change finding and what I need to change in my code.
